body:
## What (closes the MVP definition in plan §3)

Files: `src/live.rs`, `tests/cli_polish.rs`. No tui/, agents.rs, prs.rs or Cargo changes; no new deps.

body:
## What (plan §3 — the MVP demo)
- `src/live.rs`: `LiveSource` implements the TUI's `Source` over real data: `agents::discover` → Agents rows (state, `waiting_for`, age from the registry or `/proc/<pid>/stat`, cwd, branch, title, last prompt, raw detail JSON); `Board` → active claims and the last 50 entries; `load` from `/proc/loadavg`; the `~/.bf/AGENT_CHAT.md` digest is regenerated with a **Live agents** section on the first snapshot, every 30 s while the screen runs, and after any stop/note/expire. `stop` → `runner::stop` + a board `stop` entry as the operator; `note` → addressed board note; `expire_claim` → release "expired by operator".
- `src/runner.rs`: `stop(pid)`: refuses pid ≤ 1, anything in bf's own ancestry, and bf's own process group; pgid from `/proc/<pid>/stat` field 5 (never assumed = pid); `/bin/kill -TERM -- -pgid`, poll ≤ 5 s, then `-KILL` ≤ 2 s; zombies count as gone. Unit tests for the stat parser and the guards.
- `src/main.rs`: bare `bf` → `tui::run(LiveSource)`; `bf stop <pid>` → human-only guard (`identity::current`), then stop + record. Nothing else changed.
- `tests/cli_wiring.rs`: bare `bf` without a tty prints `AGENTS (0)` / `CLAIMS (0)` under empty fixture dirs, then `CLAIMS (1)` with `c-1` after a claim; `bf stop 1` → exit 2; `bf stop <own-group sleep>` → exit 0 "after TERM", the process is gone and `bf board --all` shows the `stop` entry (the test pins `BF_PROC` to a tree containing only the target so the guard is deterministic under any shell).

title: TUI shell: Agents / Board / PRs screens over the Source trait (plan PR 6)
body:
## What
The operator screen (plan §3.5), transplanted from the legacy kernel's `tui/ui.rs`/`model.rs` patterns and rebuilt on the `Source` trait the skeleton defined, so it lands before live data:
- `src/tui/mod.rs`: `run(Box<dyn Source>)`; loader thread + mpsc (snapshot every 2 s), 100 ms crossterm poll, `RestoreTerminal` drop guard, paint-before-first-data; not a tty or `TERM=dumb` → `plain()` and exit 0; `BF_TUI_ONCE=1` → one frame to stdout (tests/CI).

- `src/tui/ui.rs`: `Palette::{none,truecolor,indexed,detect}` (`NO_COLOR` wins), 2-line status | 45/55 list+detail (vertical < 85 cols) | footer, overlays, follow-tail scroll clamp.
- `src/tui/text.rs`: `terminal_text` strips C0/C1 controls, ESC/OSC sequences and Unicode bidi overrides before anything reaches the terminal.
- Keys as specified: `1 2 3`, `Tab/BackTab`, `j/k/↑/↓`, `Enter`, `Esc`, `/`, `J`, `r`, `t`, `?`, `q`/`Ctrl+C`; Agents `x` (confirm → `Source::stop`) and `n` (note to agent); Board `n`, `x` (confirm → expire claim); PRs `o` prints the URL.

title: Board: claims, heartbeats, proof releases, addressed notes, generated AGENT_CHAT.md (plan PR 5)
body:
## What
`src/board.rs` becomes real (plan §3.3), with the CLI glue the skeleton's `bf claim|heartbeat|release|note|board` arms call:
- **Storage**: `~/.bf/bf.sqlite` (or `$BF_DATA_DIR`), one append-only `board` table with immutability triggers, `jobs` (for PR 9), `inbox_seen`. WAL, 2 s busy timeout, IMMEDIATE transactions with bounded retry. No hub, no lock: any agent shell writes one short transaction.
- **Claims**: repo-relative paths (dir ends with `/`; `dir/**` accepted as `dir/`; `..`/absolute/globs rejected); overlap = component-wise prefix; conflict → exit 2 naming holder, id, expiry and intent; identical re-claim by the same agent is idempotent; default TTL 30 m, max 3 h.
- **Heartbeat/release**: `expires_at = now + ttl`; heartbeat or release on an expired claim → `STALE` (exit 2). `bf release <id> --proof '<cmd>'` runs the command in the claim's repo (15-min cap, 1 MiB capture, own process group) and records `exit`, `sha256` of output, `git status --porcelain` paths and `HEAD`.
- **Notes**: `--to <agent> | --re <claim> | --pr <url>`; unaddressed notes are ≤ 280-byte status lines. `bf board --to me` prints the caller's inbox; every write prints `N note(s) addressed to you` while unread.
- **Identity**: `--as`/`BF_AGENT` declared name plus the observed provider/pid from `/proc` (PR 4's `identity.rs`).
- **Digest**: every write and `bf board` atomically regenerate `~/.bf/AGENT_CHAT.md` (`# BulletFarm board — GENERATED …`, active claims, recent 30, `<!-- bf:end -->`); hand-written lines after the marker are imported as `legacy-md` notes. The "Live agents" section is filled by the discovery PR.

## Acceptance (plan §4, PR 5) — `tests/cli_board.rs`, black-box via the binary
`claim src/ -m a --as codex-1` → 0 · `claim src/api.rs -m b --as claude-orch` → 2 naming `codex-1`/`c-1` · `release c-1 --proof 'true'` → 0 with `exit 0` · second claim → 0 · repeat release → 2 (stale) · addressed note + `board --to claude-orch` · digest header + `c-` · straggler after end marker → `legacy-md` · `--ttl 9h` → 64 · `$HOME/.bf` created 0700.
Local: fmt/clippy `-D warnings` clean; `cargo test` lib 17 + cli_board 2 + cli_skeleton 5 + core 3; `bash scripts/check` EXIT 0 (17 s isolated).

The host transition (install, archive the current AGENT_CHAT.md, symlink) is a separate operator step recorded on the board after merge — not in this PR.

## Review
Reviewer must be a different vendor (grok, codex or cursor): `REVIEW: approve <head-sha>` via `gh pr review --comment`, then `gh pr merge --rebase --delete-branch`.

body:
## What

A declared name never hides which process wrote (spec §13).

## Why

## What

- One hub command/job/recovery loop with SQLite, hashed loopback sessions, and generated v3 wire types
- Embedded Vite/React workbench (goal → review plan → start work → pause/stop)
- Deterministic `bf demo --fixture basic` and `interrupted_publish` (always `fake: true`)
- `scripts/check`: fmt, clippy -D, tests, typecheck, Playwright journeys, both demos
- Honest `BUILD_CHECKPOINT.json`: first-release gate remains false

## Not in this PR

Live Codex/Cursor/Grok, disposable isolation, real GitHub publication, or a TUI. Those are later stacked PRs.

## Verification

Local `bash scripts/check` exit 0 on this head (`9f03362`): 8 lib + 12 acceptance + 28 hardening tests, 1 UI test, 4 Chromium journeys, both fixture demos.

## HOLD

No provider keys, enrollments, live grants, or operator decisions.
